{{Quote|Telissa? Oh, sorry. I thought you were my assistant.|Uta S'orn, to Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="The Deadly Hunter" />}}
'''Telissa''' was an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Uta S'orn]]<ref name="The Deadly Hunter" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Belasco system/Legends|Belasco system]]</ref> [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] prior to S'orn's resignation from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]<ref name="The Deadly Hunter" /> in [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].<ref name="43 BBY">According to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter]]'', which include [[Uta S'orn]]'s resignation, occur in [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].</ref> When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] came to visit S'orn in her office in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly before she resigned, she first mistook Jinn's knocking for Telissa's when answering the door.<ref name="The Deadly Hunter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Telissa was created by author [[Jude Watson]] and was mentioned in [[Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter|''The Deadly Hunter'']], the [[2000]] eleventh installment of the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] young reader novel series.<ref name="The Deadly Hunter" />
